investigate: Science capital describes students’ science-related resources, but online learning adds conditions such as ==device access and digital participation==.
The authors developed a ==questionnaire on online science capital== from Bourdieu’s theory and Archer et al.’s framework.
It was completed by ==364 Taiwanese junior high school students== alongside two aspiration items.
find: The analyses gave preliminary evidence for ==eight sub-dimensions== of online science capital.
Males scored higher than females in ==online science self-efficacy and online science investments==.
Online science capital was ==positively associated with science aspirations==; learning attitude and self-efficacy remained significant predictors of study and job aspirations.

caption.question: What resources do students draw on when they learn science online?
caption.intro: Chen and Tsai report the initial development of **an online science capital questionnaire** with 364 Taiwanese junior high school students and examine its links to science aspirations.
